display.purpose: Hero title-page numerals and names; standalone stat numerals on dark blocks.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, tags, meta keys, stat captions, footer credit — always mono, uppercase, tracked wide.

cta.purpose: The two contact buttons only (Download CV / email), 40px at hero/footer scale or 18px inline.

shadows.name: sticker-lift
shadows.purpose: The system's only shadow — lifts the rotated sticker badge off its block.

motion.name: block-rise
motion.purpose: Blocks rise in on load, respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: btn-lift
motion.purpose: Button hover state — the only interactive motion in the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-on-canvas mono button with a hover lift; the system's only call-to-action shape.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; background: #1b1620; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.9rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0b429; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Small mono pill labeling a stack item or attribute; flips to translucent white on dark blocks.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 500; background: #1b1620; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sticker Badge
components.description: Rotated stat badge, the system's single loudest device — one per surface, carrying one real number.
components.css: .ds-sticker { position: relative; display: inline-block; background: #f0b429; color: #1b1620; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.74rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border-radius: 999px; transform: rotate(-6deg); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.14); text-align: center; line-height: 1.3; width: 8rem; } .ds-sticker strong { display: block; font-family: 'Fixel Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }

components.name: Block Card (candle)
components.description: Full-bleed color-block container, candle variant, 32px radius, no shadow, no border.
components.css: .ds-block { border-radius: 32px; padding: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 4.5rem) clamp(1.5rem, 6vw, 4.25rem); position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-block--candle { background: #ff5000; color: #1b1620; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; }

components.name: Colophon List Row
components.description: Two-column mono key/value row for dense facts on dark blocks; collapses to one column under 720px.
components.css: .ds-colophon { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-colophon li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.3rem 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(245,243,236,0.18); font-size: 0.98rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-colophon-key { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.76rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #f0b429; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-colophon li { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.3rem; } }

components.name: CTA Button (blue)
components.description: Download CV — the site's only blue button. Appears at 300px/40px in the footer and flex-grown/18px inline in the hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { font-family: 'Fixel Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -0.04em; background: #3765f7; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 300px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: #1b1620; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: CTA Button (gray)
components.description: Email contact — paired with CTA Button (blue), same hover inversion to ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta-light { font-family: 'Fixel Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -0.04em; background: #f3f4f6; color: #1b1620; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 140px; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-cta-light:hover { background: #1b1620; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: The system reads as a physical invitation card, not a web app: one full-bleed color block per topic, stacked like the sections of a paper program, each holding a huge geometric numeral or headline that could be printed on card stock. A single rotated sticker badge carries the one number worth remembering per viewport. Labels and stats speak in a dev-tool monospace, a knowing wink that this printed object was actually generated in days, not weeks. The system deliberately commits to one printed world rather than an adaptive UI: no light/dark branching, no theme switching.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed color blocks, one hue per topic, stacked vertically with generous rounded corners
Huge geometric display numerals and headlines set in a variable display face
Dev-tool monospace for every label, tag, stat, and footer credit line
Exactly one rotated sticker badge per surface, carrying the single most important stat
Flat by default; the sticker's drop shadow is the system's only elevation device
Single-theme commitment — no prefers-color-scheme or data-theme branching anywhere

rules.name: The One Hue Per Block Rule
rules.body: A .block owns exactly one background color from the palette and applies it full-bleed to the whole section — colors are never mixed within a single block or scattered as small accents across a neutral ground.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Any text that names, tags, or measures something (eyebrow, tag, meta key, stat caption) is JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked wide — never the display or body face, however short the string.

rules.name: The Sticker-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow is reserved for the one rotated sticker badge per surface. No other component — button, tag, card, block — ever carries a box-shadow.

dos: Do give every block exactly one palette color, full-bleed, with no gradient or mixing.
Do keep every label, tag, meta key, and stat caption in JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked wide.
Do reserve the sticker badge for a single, real, load-bearing stat — never decorative.
Do constrain block content to a 40–44rem inner column even at full block width, so text stays readable against the color field.
Do use 900-weight display numerals (wax-gold on dark blocks) for standalone stats.
donts: Don't add prefers-color-scheme or data-theme branching — this system commits to one printed world, not an adaptive UI.
Don't add a shadow to anything except the sticker badge.
Don't use more than one sticker badge per viewport.
Don't introduce hard square corners; every rectangle carries at least an 8px radius.
Don't number case studies or index entries in a way that implies a series ("Кейс · 01") until a second entry actually exists.
